analysis: Documentation-only PR. docs/developer/test.md adds a 'Performance Observation Ordering' section (head lines 347-361) describing EngineMeasurementOrderingTests, run with a no-model, no-GPU command. docs/reference/protocol-messages.md (patch hunk near head lines 575-584) clarifies that sample_age_ms is measured from the newest observation, even when an older completed observation arrives later, and that the Swift producer applies this rule per workload bucket and per posture series. It also states that the wire fields are unchanged and that the receipt-order EWMA and sample counts are preserved. No source code, auth, attestation, encryption, key-handling or protocol schema change is visible in the supplied evidence. This touches no TB-011/T-053 authorization boundaries and no TB-002 crypto. The one security-adjacent aspect is that provider-reported performance telemetry (the sample-age and bucket fields) is provider-supplied, hence untrusted by design under ADV-001, and the PR adds no trust claim for it. The referenced implementation (EnginePerformanceMeasurements.swift) and the tests are not in the supplied evidence, so the doc's behavioral claims about them are unverified. They affect only freshness and routing-performance estimates, not serving authorization. No findings.
